name: autoclarity-site
description: getautoclarity.com — static marketing site plus the Las Vegas PPI portal (Cloudflare Pages Functions + D1 + R2).

scripts.dev: wrangler pages dev . --port 8788 --compatibility-date 2026-07-01 --d1 DB=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 --r2 UPLOADS=autoclarity-ppi-uploads --binding PPI_ENV=preview --binding PPI_MODE=request --binding PAYMENTS_ENABLED=false --binding STRIPE_ENV=test --binding BOOKING_ENABLED=true --binding UPLOADS_ENABLED=true --binding SMS_ENABLED=false --binding TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY=1x00000000000000000000AA --binding PUBLIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8788 --binding SUPPORT_EMAIL=support@getautoclarity.com
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply autoclarity_ppi --config wrangler.local.toml --local
scripts.test: npm run facts:check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
